titulo.estudio: Un mode d'emploi : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: An instruction manual: Finding the details

intro: Put the steps and conditions in order for using an appliance safely. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Put the steps and conditions in order for using an appliance safely. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: the imperative gives direct instructions; « avant de » and « après avoir » order actions. In this passage, «brancher» means «to plug in».

frases.estudio: Avant de brancher l'appareil, vérifiez que le réservoir d'eau est correctement installé.
frases.alumno: Before plugging in the appliance, check that the water tank is properly installed.

frases.estudio: Appuyez sur le bouton principal et attendez que le voyant vert s'allume.
frases.alumno: Press the main button and wait until the green indicator light comes on.
